description: This file defines TypeScript interfaces and classes related to snapshot recording and management for HTTP requests and responses. It includes classes SnapshotRecorder and SnapshotAgent, with associated options, snapshot data structures, and methods for handling snapshots.

classes.name: SnapshotRecorder
classes.description: Class responsible for recording, finding, loading, saving, and managing snapshots of HTTP request-response cycles.

classes.name: SnapshotAgent
classes.description: Extends MockAgent to include snapshot management features such as saving, loading, clearing, and deleting snapshots.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a request and response pair.

methods.name: findSnapshot
methods.description: Finds a stored snapshot matching request options.

methods.name: loadSnapshots
methods.description: Loads snapshots from a file.

methods.name: saveSnapshots
methods.description: Saves current snapshots to a file.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all snapshots.

methods.name: getSnapshots
methods.description: Returns all stored snapshots.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of snapshots.

methods.name: resetCallCounts
methods.description: Resets call counts for snapshots.

methods.name: deleteSnapshot
methods.description: Deletes a specific snapshot based on request options.

methods.name: getSnapshotInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about a specific snapshot.

methods.name: replaceSnapshots
methods.description: Replaces current snapshots with provided snapshot data.

methods.name: getRecorder
methods.description: Returns the SnapshotRecorder instance.
